items.title: INV-034/Q-021: goal-maintenance-vs-avoidance-only ablation (FULL vs AVOIDANCE_ONLY vs RANDOM, post-SD-012/MECH-306/SD-057)
items.note: IGW-20260801-222 (claim INV-034, backlog EVB-0242, companion claim Q-021). Prior draft-only design pass (session frosty-satoshi-2e7cbc, DESIGN.md + STATUS_AND_OPEN_QUESTIONS.md) found three prior lineages tried this exact shape and all failed at the same prerequisite: v3_exq_085/085c/085d/085e (INV-034, 2026-03-23/24), v3_exq_072b_q021_behavioral_flatness (Q-021, self-marked evidence_direction=superseded), v3_exq_331_arc030_approach_avoidance_balance (ARC-030, non_contributory -- Go sub-channel made zero difference, not a crash). That prerequisite (z_goal never seeding / seeding collapsing at contact) is now resolved: SD-012 drive-scaled seeding + MECH-306 drive_floor fix (V3-EXQ-582a PASS) + SD-057 object-bound incentive salience (V3-EXQ-514o PASS) closed goal_pipeline GAP-1 through GAP-7 by 2026-06-15. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b) checked live 2026-08-01: zero failure_autopsy_*.json targets tag INV-034/Q-021/ARC-030 -- brake does not fire. claims.yaml INV-034.evidence_quality_note 'hold pending architectural discussion of z_goal seeding' is stale relative to this. 3-arm ablation (FULL goal+avoidance vs AVOIDANCE_ONLY goal_weight=0.0 vs RANDOM baseline), current validated knobs (drive_floor=0.9, drive_ema_alpha=1.0 per MECH-306). Lightweight direct-REEConfig harness used (draft's 'Option A'), per default instruction -- nothing in current repo state showed it broken for a similar claim; the full scaffolded_sd054_onboarding curriculum ('Option B') is the documented fallback if a real run's G0 non-degeneracy gate fails, exactly as it was for goal_pipeline GAP-2 historically. G0 non-degeneracy precondition (Q-021's own pre-registered requirement) gates the whole run to non_contributory rather than a false weakens if FULL itself comes in flat; C1/C2 hold harm-avoidance and survival comparable between arms as the agency-vs-competence control (MECH-180 death-vs-quiescence guard); C3-C5 test the predicted quiescence/entropy signature; C6 is a mechanistic z_goal-engagement check. API re-verified 2026-08-01 against live ree_core/ source (skill Step 3) -- FOUND AND FIXED a real bug the draft had flagged as unconfirmed: the draft's z_goal read (getattr(agent,'z_goal',...) or getattr(agent._current_latent,'z_goal',...)) was wrong on both branches (REEAgent has no .z_goal; LatentState carries no z_goal field) and would have silently zeroed the C6 mechanistic check for both arms; fixed to read agent.goal_state.z_goal (GoalState.z_goal property), confirmed live in agent.py/goal.py. Also added arm_results/arm_cell fingerprinting (mint-as-you-go default, not requested for reuse), z_goal_stream wiring via ZGoalStreamAccumulator, and a fresh-selection-vs-hold-weighted entropy split (policy_entropy_fresh_select, diagnostic-only) after validate_experiments.py flagged the realized-action policy_entropy (load-bearing C5) as a hold-weighted-E3-readout advisory -- C5 stays gated on the realized/behavioural statistic (matches INV-034's own 'does nothing' language) with the fresh-select figure recorded alongside for triage. validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 findings (clean after the fixes above). Smoke test (--dry-run): all 9 seed x condition cells (3 seeds x FULL/AVOIDANCE_ONLY/RANDOM) ran to completion, verdict PASS x9, manifest written+relocated out of evidence/ correctly, z_goal_stream active_frac=0.087 writer_calls=287 writer_defect=False (confirms update_z_goal is live and correctly wired), G0 correctly self-routed FAIL/non_contributory on the tiny toy-scale dry run (3 episodes) as designed -- not a bug. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout (resource_visit_rate / z_goal_norm_at_contact under a FULL-vs-AVOIDANCE_ONLY-vs-RANDOM ablation on the post-SD-012/MECH-306/SD-057 substrate) is not recorded in any existing manifest -- the three prior lineages predate the substrate fix and carry no substrate_hash; not recoverable by reanalysis -> proceed to author. Does not supersede any single prior ID (085/072b/331 all pre-date the fix).

items.title: ARC-062/MECH-309 full-budget replication of V3-EXQ-859: lateral_pfc route_source vs none ablation, MECH-448/449 engagement (~7.7h)
items.note: ARC-062/MECH-309 FULL-TRAINING-BUDGET replication of V3-EXQ-859's lateral_pfc-vs-none route_source ablation (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-859_2026-08-01.md, user-confirmed routing: "chip the full-training-budget (~7.7h) replication now ... rather than deferring the compute-cost judgment call to /governance"). BACKGROUND: V3-EXQ-851 (full ~7.7h, P0=200/P1=90/P2=60, seeds 42/43/44) found MECH-448 (F-eligibility demotion) completely dead (0.0) under modulatory_channel_route_source='lateral_pfc', vs robustly live (17.76) under 'cand_world_summary' in matched-stack template V3-EXQ-654j (same seeds). V3-EXQ-859 (cheap ~45min diagnostic, P0=10/P2=10, no P1) compared 'lateral_pfc' vs 'none' at the same seeds to isolate whether route_source itself is causal: MECH-448 was ALIVE in BOTH arms (3/3 seeds each) -- did NOT reproduce 851's collapse under either value. MECH-449 was dead in BOTH arms, matching its deadness in 851. Two readings remained undistinguished: (a) route_source has no causal effect on MECH-448 at all -- 851's diagnosis needs a different explanation; or (b) route_source's effect is training-duration-dependent and only emerges over a longer run, which 859's 45-minute probe cannot detect by construction. THIS RUN: same 2-arm ablation (modulatory_channel_route_source='lateral_pfc' vs 'none'), same seeds (42/43/44), same matched-stack config as V3-EXQ-859 (use_candidate_rule_field=True fixed on both arms, USE_F_ELIGIBILITY_DEMOTION/USE_GO_NOGO_CONSTITUTION/USE_DACC/USE_MODULATORY_SELECTION_AUTHORITY/USE_MODULATORY_CHANNEL_ROUTING all matched, identical ENV_KWARGS, identical CRF maturity levers, identical SD-056 online e2 training) but extended to FULL budget matching V3-EXQ-851's own schedule exactly: P0=200/P1=90/P2=60 (350 episodes/cell x 200 steps x 3 seeds x 2 arms = 420000 ticks, ~7.67h on the cloud fleet per 851's own measured elapsed_seconds=27623). P1 (bias-head REINFORCE training) is reused verbatim from V3-EXQ-851's own machinery -- 859 skipped P1 as out-of-scope for its structural-engagement question, but running it here reproduces 851's training schedule structurally, not just numerically, and does not privilege either arm since agent.lateral_pfc exists and trains on BOTH arms regardless of route_source. Primary readout is UNCHANGED from V3-EXQ-859 (NOT a rebuild of V3-EXQ-851's full C1(a-g) readiness gate + C2 committed-class-entropy falsifier apparatus): MECH-448 (f_eligibility_demotion_active_frac + mean f_eligibility_excluded_count) and MECH-449 (go_nogo_active_frac + mean safety+soft suppressions) engagement, latch-cleared on every P2 tick. claim_ids=[] (matches V3-EXQ-859's own convention -- routing diagnostic, not new MECH-309/ARC-062 evidence); experiment_purpose='diagnostic'; supersedes=null (does NOT supersede V3-EXQ-859 -- 859's short-budget result stands on its own terms as a correctly-self-routed 'needs_full_replication' finding, this is a duration-extended follow-up, not a bug-fix correction). COMPUTE COST -- FLAGGED EXPLICITLY, deliberate user judgment call (2026-08-01, chip-20260801-859-full-replication): this is a real ~7.7-HOUR compute commitment. Accepted because V3-EXQ-858 (ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-B, a 1200-minute/20-hour 4-rung f_weight attenuation ladder run) is ALREADY sitting suspended pending exactly this question -- the cost of running this once is smaller than leaving that allocation suspended indefinitely on an ambiguous short-probe result. THIS RESULT DETERMINES WHETHER V3-EXQ-858 CAN BE UNBLOCKED: V3-EXQ-858's own matched-stack config presupposes MECH-448/449 are active under lateral_pfc routing, which is exactly what is in question here. NOTE (observed at queue time, 2026-08-01): the current experiment_queue.json snapshot shows V3-EXQ-858 status='claimed' on ree-cloud-4 since 2026-08-01T12:44:33Z, not 'suspended' -- a coordinator-side hold/suspend action may not be reflected in this git-derived queue view (holds are coordinator-side per CLAUDE.md 'Phase-3 queue lever depends on op'); flagged for the user/governance to reconcile, not resolved by this queue entry. Code review (Step 3.5): script is a near-verbatim merge of V3-EXQ-859's agent config + MECH-448/449 latch-cleared readout (copied unchanged) with V3-EXQ-851's P0/P1/P2 phase structure + REINFORCE bias-head training machinery (copied unchanged, constants LR_LPFC_BIAS/ REINFORCE_BATCH_SIZE/OUTCOME_BUF_MAX/POLICY_TEMPERATURE/ADV_MIN_THRESHOLD/EMA_DECAY reused verbatim from 851). claim tagging, diagnostic adjudication (one readiness precondition, measured/threshold/met, load_bearing sample_adequate criterion, criteria_non_degenerate for both mechanisms), substrate API correctness, latch-clearing, progress instrumentation ([train] ep N/M with M=350 the loop bound, verdict PASS/FAIL per seed*arm = 6 lines, Seed/ Condition boundary lines), output contract (run_id _v3, architecture_epoch, outcome exact field, write_flat_manifest stamps recording core, z_goal_stream wired via ZGoalStreamAccumulator), runner conformance (emit_outcome at end of __main__, dry_run threaded through) all verified against current source. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = MECH-448/449 engagement under lateral_pfc-vs-none route_source at FULL training budget, matched seeds. Checked: V3-EXQ-851 tested lateral_pfc alone (matched constant, not swept) at full budget; V3-EXQ-859 tested the lateral_pfc-vs-none sweep but only at SHORT budget (P0=10 vs this run's P0=200); no manifest anywhere sweeps route_source at matched seeds AND full training budget. Not recoverable by reanalysis -> proceed to author. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): claim_ids=[]; not a claim-bearing test, brake does not apply. validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 findings across all checks. Smoke test (--dry-run): both arms x 1 seed complete cleanly through P0/P1/P2, verdict PASS x2, manifest written+cleaned, [smoke] z_goal_stream: active_frac=0.000 ticks=0/320 writer_calls=320 goal_state_present=True -- correctly wired, no writer defect (zero active_frac expected on the tiny dry-run dose). See REE_assembly/evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-859_2026-08-01.md (+.json) for the full autopsy this replication answers, and experiments/v3_exq_859_arc062_lateral_pfc_route_mech448_449_ablation.py / experiments/v3_exq_851_arc062_pa_lateral_pfc_route_source_gapfanout.py for the two scripts this one merges. PRIORITY LOWERED 2026-08-01T19:08Z (44 -> 15, user instruction): discovered post-queue that V3-EXQ-858 was NOT actually suspended (coordinator /shadow/status showed it live-running on ree-cloud-4 since 2026-08-01T12:44:33Z, 41.4% complete at check time) -- the 859 autopsy's premise was stale. V3-EXQ-858 reuses V3-EXQ-851's C1(a-g) readiness gates verbatim, including C1(e)/C1(f) (MECH-448/449 non-vacuity), at full budget under lateral_pfc routing across 4 f_weight rungs x 3 seeds -- so its own manifest (ETA ~6.7h from 19:04Z) will likely already carry a full-budget MECH-448/449 engagement reading for the lateral_pfc arm, one half of what V3-EXQ-863 measures. V3-EXQ-863 still supplies the 'none' comparator arm 858 cannot (route_source is a matched constant there, not swept), so both are kept in the queue and both should run -- but 863 is deprioritized below the rest of the active portfolio so it does not compete for a worker against other queued work while 858 finishes and its C1(e)/C1(f) result becomes available to cross-check against.
